question: Who among the following was appointed as the Director General of CRPF in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanendra Pratap Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gyanendra Pratap Singh was appointed as the Director General of the **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)** in January 2025.
 
• He succeeded **Sujay Lal Thakur**, who held the position previously.
 
• Gyanendra Pratap Singh, an IPS officer of the **1987 Assam-Meghalaya cadre**, has served in various distinguished roles across his career.
 
• CRPF is India's largest paramilitary force, responsible for internal security, counter-insurgency, and anti-terrorist operations.
 
• His appointment aims to strengthen the operational efficiency and modernization of CRPF for better security management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)**

 
 
• Established in **1939** as the Crown Representative's Police and renamed CRPF after independence in 1949.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The CRPF is tasked with maintaining law and order, combating insurgency, and assisting in disaster relief operations.
 
• It is the largest paramilitary force in India, with over 300,000 personnel.
 
 
 
• **Role of Director General (DG)**
 
 
• The DG is the highest-ranking officer in the CRPF and is responsible for its overall leadership, strategy, and operations.
 
• The DG ensures the force operates effectively in coordination with other security agencies.
 
 
 
• **Key Operations by CRPF**
 
 
• CRPF plays a critical role in counter-insurgency operations in Jammu and Kashmir and the Northeast.
 
• It also leads anti-Naxal operations in Left-Wing Extremism (LWE)-affected regions.
 
• The CRPF provides security for elections and sensitive installations.
 
 
 
• **Modernization Initiatives**
 
 
• CRPF has been modernizing its equipment and training to adapt to emerging challenges.
 
• It has incorporated advanced technologies such as drones, AI-based surveillance systems, and improved communication tools.
